content.about: The Bahamas is a chain of about 700 islands in the Atlantic, near Florida. Its shallow seas glow turquoise. Pig Beach has swimming pigs. Junkanoo is a colourful street festival.

standout.text: Dean's Blue Hole is one of the deepest known blue holes in the world, about 200 m deep.

didYouKnow: Swimming pigs live on Big Major Cay.
Andros Barrier Reef is one of the largest.
Pink sand beaches are on Harbour Island.
